structured_output.content: The environment summary does not report whether ACME issuers (ClusterIssuer or Issuer with ACME) are deployed. The change adds support for an ACME protocol extension, which plausibly affects any environment using ACME for certificate issuance. To determine applicability, check whether your manifests include ClusterIssuer or Issuer resources with acme config, and review the release notes for whether this extension is opt-in or automatic.
